utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Morning all, you alright? Let's get cracking, Wednesday stand-up. Quick one if we can, just go round and shout if there's anything ugly.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning. Bit grim out there again, innit. Proper sideways rain. Weekend's meant to be better though, so I'm hanging onto that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, if the forecast's not lying for once. Also, er, don't forget the charity bake sale on Friday. My missus has already volunteered me to bring something, so cheers for that.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: As long as someone saves me a bit. There was a birthday cake in the office yesterday and it got absolutely demolished before I got back from samples.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: You were too slow, Han. Morning all.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Morning.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Morning, all.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right. Any safety or overnight stuff first?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Nothing major. Just so no one logs it again, I already swapped the filter on the fire panel yesterday, so that's done, not for today. And I already swapped the filter on the line 3 barrel yesterday as well, before anyone asks.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: On nights I noticed the HV board was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down. I'm not raising that as a job, just worth keeping an eye on if anyone's in there.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Same sort of thing from me, noticed the guard switch on two was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down. Didn't trip, no alarms, just an observation really.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine. So watch-and-wait, not new work.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Planning-wise, two blockers still sat there. The supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the line 3, so that one's not moving. And we're still waiting on parts for the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, parked then. David, anything mechanical?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Not loads. Fiona, you said GT2—just to stop duplication, has the main repair actually been closed?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, finished the repair on the Gas Turbine 2 last night. That's complete, separate thing from the inlet water injection valve parts issue.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Good, ta.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Okay. I've got one I'll pick up myself — I'll check the guarding on the palletiser on Monday. Been meaning to get eyes on it properly rather than just the quick walk-by.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Nice one, Priya. Proper check, interlocks and physical condition?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, full look over. I'll check the guarding on the palletiser Monday and feed back if there's anything daft.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: What else is floating about that actually needs agreeing today?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: There's the relief valve one. We do need to book a contractor to look at the relief valve; that needs doing this week, ideally by 11am if we're going to stand a chance of getting someone lined up.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Who can take that?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I've not got the bandwidth this morning, I'm tied up with the press gearbox.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'm flat out on breakdown follow-ups, to be honest.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I'm off site half the day.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right... so it still needs doing this week, by 11am, but no owner's jumping on it at the minute.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Okay, leave it visible then: book a contractor to look at the relief valve, needs doing this week by 11am, and currently nobody's picked it up.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I've got a quality side one. The sensors on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve are drifting again. I'll recalibrate the sensors on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve first thing tomorrow; that needs doing this week before we trust the trend properly.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Say that again just so Fiona can catch it.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah — I'll recalibrate the sensors on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve first thing tomorrow. It needs doing this week, and I'll handle it.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Got it, Hannah on that first thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: While we're on tomorrow and all that, not a task for anyone else, but I'll do a site visit at Kestrel with the contractor after lunch. Low priority, mainly because if they shuffle the slot it won't hurt us.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's today after lunch, Marc, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, after lunch today. I'll do a site visit at Kestrel with the contractor, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Fine. Keep us posted if they find anything interesting.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: There's also the permit side for GT2. We still need to sort the permit to work and isolation for the Gas Turbine 2 by the 28th.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Can anyone own that now?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Not me, sorry. I'm not touching permits today, I'm already stacked.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I can't commit either, if I'm doing Kestrel and handover bits.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So that's another one with no owner then. It does still need to happen by the 28th, just nobody in this room's taking it right now.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Logged as a gap then: sort the permit to work and isolation for the Gas Turbine 2 by the 28th, and nobody's picked it up in here.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And from me, on the production side, I'll grease and check the bearings on the Line 3 Screw and Barrel today. Fairly important, because it's been a bit grumbly on startup.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: You're happy with that, Han? Need a fitter with you?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I should be alright. If it turns into more than grease and check then I'll shout, but for now I'll grease and check the bearings on the Line 3 Screw and Barrel today. Fairly important, mind.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Good. Marcus, anything admin-wise?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll send the shift handover report round after lunch. I didn't get it out first thing because the historian was being painfully slow.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: As long as it lands after lunch, that's fine.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, I'll send the shift handover report round after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Can I just check on line 3 while we're here — Hannah's bearing check is today, but the supplier issue is still separate, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, separate. Mine's local checks only. The supplier still not confirming delivery for the line 3 is a blocker, but it's not stopping me doing the grease and inspection today.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Makes sense.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And just so nobody turns it into a job, that warm guard switch on two thing, it genuinely settled down. I don't want three work orders off one warm panel door.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, fair. We heard you the first time, Tom.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Alright, alright, just saying.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Anything else completed that people might accidentally chase?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: No, apart from the two filters I mentioned, both done yesterday, definitely not today's list.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And again, repair on the Gas Turbine 2 was finished last night, so don't roll that into the permit conversation. Different thing.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Any staffing headaches?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Only the usual. If the contractor booking for the relief valve gets picked up late, we're into next week, which is why I said it needs doing this week by 11am. But as of now, no owner.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Understood. We can't magic a person out of nowhere though.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: If I'm clear after the Boiler Safety Relief Valve stuff first thing tomorrow I can maybe advise, but I can't commit to owning the contractor booking.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That's fine, let's not muddy it. No owner on the relief valve booking at the moment.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And before anyone asks me twice, Kestrel's still low priority. I'll go after lunch, but if ops kicks off here, that'll slip.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, noted.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Priya, on the palletiser, you want me to come with or are you okay?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I'll be fine. It's just me to check the guarding on the palletiser Monday, then if I find mechanical issues I'll drag you in.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Works for me.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I might nick some grease from stores before line 3, if they've not hidden it all again.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good luck. Half of stores is basically folklore at this point.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Check behind the dead biscuits in the cabinet.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Ha, probably next to the missing birthday cake.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, comedians. Anything critical we've missed?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No, summary from me's clear enough.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Go on then, quick read-back: I'll check the guarding on the palletiser Monday. Relief valve contractor booking needs doing this week by 11am, no owner yet. Hannah will recalibrate the sensors on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve first thing tomorrow, needs doing this week. Marc will do a site visit at Kestrel with the contractor after lunch, low priority. Permit to work and isolation for the Gas Turbine 2 needs sorting by the 28th, no owner. Han will grease and check the bearings on the Line 3 Screw and Barrel today, fairly important. Marcus will send the shift handover report round after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's it. Thanks everyone, get on.
